pages.title: State University — Computer Science and Business Administration Programs
pages.meta_description: Undergraduate and graduate programs at State University.
pages.main_text: State University offers Computer Science and Business Administration programs.

pages.title: Computer Science Program — Undergraduate Degree
pages.meta_description: A four-year undergraduate Computer Science degree.

headings.text: Built for research and career advancement

pages.main_text: The Computer Science program offers a Bachelor's degree over 4 years. Tuition is $12,000 per year. Ideal for undergraduate students interested in research and career advancement in technology. Financial aid and scholarships are available.

pages.title: Business Administration Program — Graduate Degree
pages.meta_description: A two-year graduate Business Administration degree.
pages.main_text: The Business Administration program is a Master's degree over 2 years. Tuition is $18,000 per year. Popular with graduate students and working professionals seeking career advancement. Accredited by AACSB.

pages.title: Admissions — International Students Welcome
pages.main_text: We welcome international students and transfer students. Contact admissions for eligibility criteria.
